observed_evidence: Google identifies copied descriptions and cookie-cutter affiliate pages as thin affiliation
what_is_not_proven: Policy text does not predict a specific site's ranking
design_rule: Every indexable page needs original evidence navigation comparison or a buyer-state function

observed_evidence: A Swedish court found unlawful self-preferencing and awarded PriceRunner damages after a long abuse period
what_is_not_proven: The award is not necessarily final collected or a startup revenue analogue
design_rule: Treat search as one distributor and build saved intent direct audience and other machine interfaces

observed_evidence: CarGurus wound down the transaction business after goodwill intangible software and related impairments and wind-down expenditure
what_is_not_proven: The filing does not prove every transaction marketplace will fail
design_rule: Do not acquire inventory take title or own complex fulfilment until the capital-light market proves an advantage

observed_evidence: Current terms allocate Shop Houzz merchant-of-record customer-service return and commerce operation to a Cart.com entity under licence
what_is_not_proven: The terms do not disclose whether prior in-house operation failed or the licensed economics
design_rule: Keep project intelligence and professional workflow core; partner for commodity fulfilment

observed_evidence: Etsy bought Reverb for 275 million dollars in 2019 and sold it in 2025 for 105 million dollars cash with 108.2 million dollars fair-value consideration and a 5.1 million dollar accounting loss
what_is_not_proven: Acquisition and sale values do not measure interim cash flow investment synergies or standalone quality
design_rule: Do not use acquisition price as product validation; test whether the vertical reinforces the parent's customer and operating system

observed_evidence: HY2026 reported revenue fell 8 percent while the company promoted direct ads Future+ Signal and lower dependence on website sessions
what_is_not_proven: Group results do not isolate product review SEO or one brand
design_rule: Build direct identity and distribution before traffic loss forces a portfolio pivot

observed_evidence: Memberships fell 4.1 percent at June 2025 and Which explicitly stops tests in obsolete or low-interest categories
what_is_not_proven: A single year's membership change does not prove structural decline
design_rule: Allocate test capital by decision value member demand and update burden; kill weak categories

observed_evidence: The tracker depends on Amazon content and affiliate links and states supplied content can change or be removed
what_is_not_proven: The notice does not establish imminent platform removal
design_rule: A platform-specific utility needs portable user relationships and independently retained observations

failure_pattern: Trust boundary left with the buyer
observed_evidence: Discogs states it does not pre-screen sellers and is not the seller or guarantor
what_is_not_proven: Policy does not prove poor buyer outcomes
design_rule: Make the transaction boundary explicit; do not imply protection the operator does not deliver

failure_pattern: Nominal economics disappear in the path
observed_evidence: Finance orders are excluded from commission despite high-ticket garden products often using finance
what_is_not_proven: The share of finance orders is unknown
design_rule: Model payable tracked transactions by checkout path instead of multiplying visible price by headline commission

failure_pattern: Broad catalogue dilutes the high-ticket thesis
observed_evidence: The retailer has high-value machinery inside a 21000-product range but reports whole-site AOV only above 100 pounds
what_is_not_proven: Category-specific AOV and conversion remain unknown
design_rule: Define the monetised subset and measure it separately from catalogue breadth

observed_evidence: Community identity can be precise while seller screening and guarantees remain limited
what_is_not_proven: The evidence does not show the optimal level of platform intervention
design_rule: Separate catalogue truth seller trust and payment protection as three products with three cost bases
